item.title: Court denies DOJ access to D.C. voter rolls
item.description: A federal judge on Thursday blocked the Justice Department's request to review the District's complete voter list, determining that the administration's request was not justified.

item.title: President's Military Options Are Dangerously Limited
item.description: It is irresponsible to rely on a single individual for all professional military advice.

item.title: Princeton Study Reveals How Georgia Votes Can Be Traced to Individuals
item.description: A Princeton researcher demonstrated that Georgia's 'secret' ballots can be linked to voters using public records.
